Know what you’re measuring

Consistent definitions from warehouse to answer.

✓ Definitions included

Item GMV

Sum of item prices for delivered orders. Excludes freight. It is not profit, net revenue, or payment receipts.

Late delivery

Actual delivery calendar date is after the estimated date. Same-day delivery is on time. Missing dates are excluded from the rate.

Time & location

Grouped by purchase calendar month and customer state. Source dates have no documented timezone. Boundary months may be partial.
